title: Plugin dock with a large minimum size hides the editor bottom panel and FileSystem dock, even while the dock tab is hidden
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in: 4.8.dev custom build [db01b4f730819cb39bce1922a7ec377b18239c0f], 4.7.1.stable ### System information Godot v4.8.dev (db01b4f73) - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.16.1062) - AMD Ryzen 9 9900X 12-Core Processor (24 threads) - 61.66 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description If an `EditorPlugin` adds a side dock via `add_control_to_dock()` whose minimum height is larger than the window, the editor opens with the **bottom panel (Output/Debugger/... tabs and the version status bar) and the FileSystem dock missing** — even though the plugin dock itself is just a hidden, never-selected tab. The missing panels are actually laid out below the bottom edge of the window. **Expected behavior**: a hidden, never-selected plugin dock does not affect the editor layout; the bottom panel and FileSystem dock stay visible. **Actual behavior**: the whole editor becomes taller than the window and the bottom panel + FileSystem dock are pushed off-screen (unreachable). ### Steps to reproduce 1. Open the attached MRP. 2. The bottom panel and the FileSystem dock are not visible; the 2D/3D workspace extends to the bottom edge of the window. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30198753/mrp.zip)
